description: Implementation of the pdxch_processor_impl class handling downlink resource processing, modulation requests, and slot processing in a radio communication system.

classes.name: pdxch_processor_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for processing downlink resource requests, modulation, and slot handling in a radio system.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a notifier to the processor.

methods.name: get_request_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the request handler interface.

methods.name: get_baseband
methods.description: Returns a reference to the baseband interface.

methods.name: get_center_freq_control
methods.description: Returns a reference to the center frequency controller.

methods.name: handle_request
methods.description: Handles incoming resource grid requests, attempting modulation and managing buffers.

methods.name: on_modulation_completion
methods.description: Handles completion of modulation, updates request buffer, and notifies late requests.

methods.name: set_carrier_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the carrier center frequency for modulation.

methods.name: process_slot
methods.description: Processes a slot, returning modulation results or notifying late requests.
